in_marathi.name: Deepika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Row of lights
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deepika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deepika refers to a row of lights, as the name of a divine lamp used during religious ceremonies. The name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'deepa' meaning 'lamp' and 'ka' meaning 'row'. Deepika signifies the illumination of knowledge and the removal of darkness from one's life. It is also believed that the name carries the blessings of the goddess Lakshmi, who embodies wealth, prosperity, and fortune.
